English.Text: Yoo-hoo! You can trade your points in right here. With me!

Text: ポイントが貯まったら　またきてね～！

English.Text: Make sure to come back once you've racked up more points!

Text: それじゃ　バイバ～イ！

English.Text: Bye! Hope to see you again!

Text:
今日は頭がさえてるから
負ける気しないよ

English.Text: I am on today. Hope y'all ready to lose.

Text:
ぼく　クイーンズ・ブラッド
好きなんですよ

English.Text: I'm actually really into Queen's Blood right now.

Text:
勝ち負けより　楽しい時間を
過ごせたかどうかが大切なんですよ

English.Text: Phew! Competition's so hot, I'm starting to feel a little feverish!

Text: 頭ガンガンする……知恵熱かな？

English.Text: My head is pounding... Maybe I'm putting too much thought into this game.

Text: よっしゃ　燃えてきた～！

English.Text: Now I'm really gettin' fired up!

Text:
勝負が終わったら　すぐ結果の分析
それが強くなるコツ

English.Text: Reflect on your matches as soon as they're over─while it's all still fresh. That's how you get good.

Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
見てるだけでも面白いな

English.Text: Queen's Blood's just as much fun to watch as it is to play.

Text: カードバウトの調子はどうだ？

English.Text: Just watching stresses me out...

Text: なるほど　そうきたか

English.Text: Ooh, that's a good play!

Text: 集中集中　がんばって！

English.Text: You got this! Just keep your head in the game!

Text: ここが正念場だぞ

English.Text: It's do-or-die now!

Text:
どんなバウトが見れるのかな
ワクワクする！

English.Text: I just hope we get to see some real matches today.

Text: 次はクイーンズ・ブラッドやりたい！

English.Text: Maybe I'll give Queen's Blood a try.

Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドって
やったことないんだけど

English.Text: I can't say I've ever played this "Queen's Blood" thing...

Text: むむ　オリジナリティあふれる一手

English.Text: Huh. Never seen anyone try that before.

Text: おお　そこから逆転狙うのね！

English.Text: Hey, it's okay! You haven't lost yet!

Text: ふう　最高だった……

English.Text: That was transcendent.

Text: 鳥肌が　まだおさまらん

English.Text: I've still got goose bumps all over.

Text: 主演の女優がマジで圧巻だったな

English.Text: The leading lady was absolutely stunning.

Text:
あの人数で踊ってピッタリ合うの
やばくないか？

English.Text: All those dancers in perfect sync? What a show!

Text: 胸がいっぱいで動けないや

English.Text: I'm still reeling from that performance.

Text: うう……本当によかった～

English.Text: Oh... It was just so beautiful!

Text: どうしよう　まだドキドキしてる

English.Text: My heart's still racing! I can't make it stop!

Text: セットの作り込み　すごくなかった？

English.Text: That set design was like nothing I've ever seen!

Text: 始まってすぐに泣いちゃうんだよね

English.Text: I just start bawling the second the show starts!

Text:
その日から　サボテンダーを従えて
砂漠の秘宝を守るようになりました

English.Text: And from that day on, he took his place as guardian of the treasure of the sands.

Text: 舞台に集中しすぎて疲れちゃった

English.Text: Their performance was just so enthralling!

Text: もしかしたら　いまでも砂漠のどこかでは

English.Text: Some believe that he's still out there, somewhere...

Text:
秘宝を狙う盗賊とゴブリンたちが
バトルを繰り広げているのかもしれませんね

English.Text: doing battle with anyone who would try to steal the precious treasure of the sands.

Text: ご清聴　ありがとうございました

English.Text: Thank you all for listening.

Text:
これより休憩タイムとなります
次の公演まで　しばらくお待ちください

English.Text: After a short break, we'll return with the next show. Be sure to stick around for it!

Text:
ご機嫌うるわしゅう　我がお客様
ゴールドポイントはお持ちかな？

English.Text: Good day and well met, most esteemed guest. Perchance you have points for me?

Text:
お客様のゴールドポイントは
我が命を懸けて　交換いたしましょう

English.Text: May I say what a tremendous honor it is to exchange these points for you.

Text: お客様と再会できる日を　心待ちにしています

English.Text: I shall eagerly await our next interaction.

Text:
またいつか　この僕に
お客様のポイントを託してください

English.Text: I pray you will entrust me with your points again. Till then, adieu.

Text: はやくワンダースクエアに行きたい～

English.Text: I wanna go to Wonderment Square!

Text:
役者って　歌っておどって
楽しそうだね

English.Text: Being an actor looks so fun! You get to sing and dance!

Text: ふわあ……寝ちゃった～

English.Text: I fell asleep.

Text: 拍手しすぎて　手がまっかっか！

English.Text: I clapped so much my hands turned red!

Text:
おはなしは難しかったけど
キレイだったね

English.Text: I couldn't follow the story, but it was super pretty!

Text:
あんないっぱいのセリフ
どうやって覚えるんだろ？

English.Text: How do they remember all their lines? There's so many!

Text: 当日券は　もうないってよ！

English.Text: Oh, damn... They're all sold out!

Text:
ＶＩＰ席を予約しておいたから
ワインを飲みながら　ゆっくり見ようよ

English.Text: I scored us VIP seats, so we can sip some nice wine and enjoy the show!

Text:
この劇場
ドレスコードってあったっけ？

English.Text: Uh-oh, does this theater have a dress code?

Text: 街の小さな劇場とは　なにもかも違うな

English.Text: This place blows our town's piddly theater right outta the water!

Text:
うしろの席から見ると
役者の実力がわかるぞ

English.Text: I prefer the cheap seats. Actors play to the back row anyway!

Text:
不朽の名作をどうアレンジしてるか
見ものだな

English.Text: Loveless is such a classic. I can't wait to see this troupe's spin on it!

Text: いつか俺も　ここの舞台に立つぞ！

English.Text: One day, I'm gonna be singing on that stage.

Text: ギリギリでナイトショーが取れたよ

English.Text: I managed to nab some tickets for the night show!

Text: かなり難解な話だけど　寝ないでね

English.Text: This might be hard to follow, but try to stay awake.

Text: 神席すぎて　心臓が持つか心配

English.Text: I can't believe I got the best seat in the house!

Text: 開演の前に　お化粧を直しとこっと

English.Text: Better fix my makeup before curtain-up.

Text:
ホテルがサプライズでＶＩＰ席を
用意してくれたの　新婚祝いだって！

English.Text: This place is so nice! They gave us VIP tickets for our honeymoon!

Text:
ＶＩＰ席のお料理
どれも美味しかった～

English.Text: The food in the VIP seats was to die for!

Text:
トップスターもいいけど
私は脇役のほうが味わい深くて好き

English.Text: The lead was great, but it was the supporting cast that really stole the show.

Text:
今夜の『LOVELESS』は　演出も音楽も
すべてが特別な豪華版らしいよ

English.Text: From what I've heard, they're pulling out all the stops for tonight's production of Loveless!

Text:
歌詞コンテストは俺がもらったぜ
最高傑作を応募したからな！

English.Text: There's no way I didn't win the contest. Those are the absolute best lyrics I've ever written!

Text:
この公演をずっと楽しみにしてたんだよ
まさか　上演してくれるとは

English.Text: I'm so glad they put this show together. I've been waiting forever to see it in person!

Text:
『Gエディション』は
観客参加型の特別なプログラムらしいぜ

English.Text: The G Edition of the show allows for audience participation. Isn't that exciting?

Text:
歌詞コンテストの作品を読んだけど
フラワーなんとかって人のが良かったな

English.Text: I read all the entries for the songwriting contest, and I really liked the one by that Maycomb person.

Text: 歌詞コンテストの結果　楽しみだよね

English.Text: I can't wait to see who wins the contest!

Text:
『LOVELESS・Gエディション』は
主演女優が降板して
ずっとお蔵入りしてたんだって

English.Text: Apparently, the reason Loveless got shelved for so long is 'cause the lead actress quit without warning.

Text:
わたし　八番街育ちだからね
『LOVELESS』にはうるさいわよ

English.Text: I grew up in Sector 8, so trust me when I say I know everything about Loveless.

Text: 新機軸の『LOVELESS』だったな！

English.Text: I've never seen Loveless like that before!

Text: 最後に出てきた歌手って誰？

English.Text: Who was that singer at the end of the show?

Text:
エンディングの曲って
歌詞コンテストのやつだろ？

English.Text: Was the final number the one from the songwriting contest?

Text:
女神役の役者が良かったな
次の作品も絶対に見るよ

English.Text: That talent who played the Goddess was divine! I need to see what they're in next.

Text:
うう……俺
感動でなにも言えねえ

English.Text: ...I don't know what to say... That was beautiful.

Text: こんな舞台　はじめて！

English.Text: I've never seen a play like that before!

Text:
フラワー・キーパーさんの歌詞
胸に染みたわ

English.Text: Maycomb Blume's lyrics hit me like an arrow straight to the heart.

Text: 最後の曲　販売されたら絶対買う！

English.Text: I hope they release that song as a single. I need it!

Text: アルフリードのファンになっちゃった

English.Text: I think I just became Alphreid's number one fan!

Text: 本当にお芝居の中にいるみたいだった

English.Text: Wow... It felt like I was right there in the middle of the action.

Text:
申し訳ございません
本日の前売り券は完売となっております

English.Text: I repeat─advance tickets for tonight's performance have sold out!

Text:
当日券は　開演の１時間前より
先着順での販売となります

English.Text: Same-day tickets will be available for purchase one hour before the show!

Text: ご希望のお客様は　お並びください

English.Text: Please line up here to wait!

Text:
同じ演目を何度も見てるけど
毎回違うから　まったく飽きないよね

English.Text: I've seen this show I don't know how many times, but somehow it never hits me the same way.

Text:
内容は同じでも　役者の体を通すことで
いい意味で揺らぎが生まれるんだよな

English.Text: It's great how a play can feel so different just by switching up the performers and adding new nuances.

Text:
そうそう　私ぐらいになると
役者がミスしてくれたほうが嬉しいよ

English.Text: I know, right? I've even come to appreciate those unexpected moments when an actor flubs their lines.

Text: わかる　アドリブが増えて面白いよな

English.Text: Yeah, me too. I say bring on the ad-libs!

Text:
勉強になるかと思ったけど
うちの劇団とはスケールが違いすぎたわ

English.Text: I figured these actors could teach us a thing or two, but they're so good, they put our troupe to shame.

Text: でも　脚本は負けてないと思いました

English.Text: But hey, at least we know your scripts are good.

Text: 劇場の大きさはどうしようもないとして

English.Text: Too bad our stage is too small for them.

Text:
問題は座長の脚本をうまく演じられない
僕たち役者陣の実力不足かと

English.Text: But the real problem is us. We can't do your characters justice. We just don't have the acting chops...

Text:
劇団員を導けていない時点で
座長である私の力が足りてないのよ

English.Text: No, the fault lies with me. As the director, I'm the one who needs to bring it all together.

Text:
ただ　最高峰を確認したことで
進むべき道が明確になったわね

English.Text: ...At least seeing the best of the best in action has helped us learn what we need to improve.

Text:
ですね　さっそく帰って
稽古をしましょう！

English.Text: Right! So let's head back and work on our craft!

Text:
ただいま　アルフリード様の
メモリアルブックの予約を受付中です！

English.Text: We're now accepting pre-orders for commemorative Alphreid photo books!

Text: 初回限定版は　なんとサイン付き！

English.Text: The limited first edition comes autographed!

Text:
メモリアルブックをいま予約すると
お渡し会の参加券がついてきます

English.Text: Buy now for a ticket to a meet and greet, and get your book from the hero himself!

Text: この機会にぜひ　お買い求めください！

English.Text: Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity!

Text:
今日見る『LOVELESS』は
古来より伝わる叙事詩が原作の舞台だ

English.Text: Not every family gets to see Loveless, or reads the epic upon which it's based.

Text:
社交界では必須の教養だから
よく見ておくように

English.Text: A cultured young man will be expected to know it quite well.

Text:
原作のほうなら読んだよ
最後がよくわからなかったな

English.Text: But I already know it. I just didn't understand the ending.

Text:
その感想は正しい　原作の最終章は
いまだに発見されてないからな

English.Text: That's because it is not the ending. The final portion of the poem remains lost to time.

Text:
その謎に多くの人間が魅了されてきた
かくいう私も　そのひとりだ

English.Text: Many a passionate individual has found themselves enthralled by the mystery of it─myself included.

Text:
甘美な謎が不朽の名作にしたってワケか
僕にはすこしロマンチックすぎるな

English.Text: So it's the mystery that makes it a timeless classic? I suppose...but I could do without the sappy romance.

Text:
イベントスクエアにお越しの皆々さま
これより『サボテン大王』を始めます！

English.Text: Attention all Event Square guests! Our Cactuar King show is about to begin!

Text: 準備は　よろしいですか？

English.Text: Is everyone ready?

Text:
それでは　灼熱の砂漠に
皆様をご案内しましょう！

English.Text: We're about to be whisked off to the desert, where cactuars reign supreme!

Text:
ある日　キッドＧという名前のゴブリンが
サボテン王国を目指して旅をしていました

English.Text: Once upon a time, a goblin named Kid G set out for the faraway kingdom of the cactuars.

Text:
何日も何日も砂漠を歩き続け
ようやく　サボテン王国に辿り着きます

English.Text: He walked for days and days across the hot sand, until finally he reached his destination.

Text:
しかし　そこに立ちふさがる
色とりどりのサボテンダーたち！

English.Text: All of a sudden, he was surrounded by colorful cactuars!

Text:
キッドＧは好戦的な笑みを浮かべ
グローブを握りしめます

English.Text: Kid G grinned menacingly, clutching his glove.

Text: カーンと鳴り響くゴング！

English.Text: "Klang!" rang the gong!

Text:
すばやく動きまわるサボテンダーたち
華麗なフットワークで応戦するキッドＧ

English.Text: The cactuars sprang into action, but Kid G was even faster!

Text: ジャブ　ジャブ　ストレート！

English.Text: Jab! Jab! Straight!

Text:
強烈なパンチが次々と決まり
見事ノックアウト　カンカンカン！

English.Text: With his every punch, he scored knockout after knockout! Ding ding ding!

Text:
すると　激しい戦いを終えたキッドＧのまえに
王冠を被ったサボテン大王がやってきました

English.Text: Soon, only one cactuar remained: a big one, with a shiny crown on his head─the king!

Text:
キッドＧは大王に　いにしえの盟約に従い
砂漠の秘宝を守りにきたのだと告げました

English.Text: Kid G told the king that he'd come to protect the treasure of the sands─to honor and fulfill an ancient pact.

Text: 大王に認められたキッドＧは

English.Text: The king welcomed Kid G.

Text:
減給かな
まさか　クビはないよな？

English.Text: Shit... Late again. I'm in for it now.

Text: 終わった　またしても遅刻

English.Text:
Wait, he wouldn't fire me, would he?
A pay cut, sure, but...

Text: バトルスクエアの迫力　ヤバかったね！

English.Text: Man, everything about Battle Square was badass!

Text:
くっそ～
クラウドに賭けときゃよかった

English.Text: Son of a bitch! Shoulda just trusted my gut!

Text:
クラウド　勝ってくれて
本当にありがとう！

English.Text: I can't thank you enough for winning, Cloud! You're the best!

Text: なんだ　なんだ？

English.Text: What the hell was that?

Text: おいおい　どうなってんだよ

English.Text: World's gettin' kinda crazy, huh?

Text:
あそこにいるのって
究極の遊び人だろ？

English.Text: Yo. Isn't that the Ultimate Party Animal?

Text: おお　神羅課長が勝負するのか？

English.Text: Oh snap, is the UPA gonna throw down?

Text: 挑戦者のお手並み拝見といこうか

English.Text: Alright then, let's see what this challenger can do!

Text: 究極の遊び人からの挑戦状だって！

English.Text: The Ultimate Party Animal's putting on his own event!

Text: 神羅課長に勝てるワケないのに

English.Text: Like anybody'd have a chance against that dude!

Text: だれが神羅課長に挑戦するの？

English.Text: I wonder who's gonna take on the champion.

Text: やっぱ強えな　神羅課長

English.Text: Yep, nobody can touch the king.

Text: いい勝負だったのに　残念だったな

English.Text: That was a great match. Shame about the end.

Text: リベンジ　楽しみにしてるぞ

English.Text: I'm looking forward to round two!

Text: 究極への道は険しいわね

English.Text: The road to the top is rough and winding.

Text: 応援してるから　次も頑張って

English.Text: You can do it─I believe in you!

Text: 神羅課長が強すぎるのよ

English.Text: That guy's something else, huh?

Text:
すげえな！
究極の遊び人に勝っちまいやがった

English.Text: Dude, how crazy is it that you beat the party animal!

Text: まさか　神羅課長が負けるなんて

English.Text: I can't believe the UPA actually lost.

Text: ナイスファイト　面白かったぞ！

English.Text: Killer fight, dude! Great stuff!

Text: 究極の遊び人が負けたってホント？

English.Text: The Ultimate Party Animal seriously lost?

Text: うそ　挑戦者が勝っちゃったの？

English.Text: The party animal lost!? No way!

Text: 神羅課長に遊びで勝つなんて……

English.Text: Didn't think anyone partied harder than him.

Text:
最高峰の遊び人バトル
シビれたぜ！

English.Text: That was wild─like, clash-of-the-gods wild!

Text: 究極の遊び人になった気分はどうだ？

English.Text: How's it feel to be crowned the new UPA?

Text: すげえ３Ｄバトルだったな！

English.Text: I've never seen a match like that!

Text: ふたりの遊びっぷりに感動しちゃった

English.Text: You two were amazing─inspirational!

Text: クラウドと神羅課長　どっちも最高！

English.Text: Both of you guys belong in the party animal hall of fame!

Text: 究極の遊び人・クラウドの誕生だね

English.Text: I can't believe I got to witness the birth of a new legend!

Text:
宇宙騎士団の諸君！
本作戦の目的は　敵母艦の破壊だ

English.Text: Space rangers! Your objective is to eliminate the enemy mother ship!

Text:
宇宙の平和は君の手にかかっている
健闘を祈るぞ！

English.Text: The fate of the universe is in your hands! Good hunting, cadets!

Text:
宇宙騎士団の諸君！
これより　敵の防衛ラインを突破し母艦を叩く

English.Text: Space rangers! Your objective is to breach enemy lines and eliminate their mother ship!

Text:
宇宙の平和は君の手にかかっている
では　行くぞ！

English.Text: The fate of the universe is in your hands! Now make us proud!

Text: 敵機確認　撃ち落とせ！

English.Text: Enemy sighted! Attack!

Text: 敵におくれをとるなよ！

English.Text: Engage! Now!

Text: 敵部隊接近中　迎撃するぞ！

English.Text: Enemy incoming. Move to intercept!

Text: ターゲット発見　１機たりとも逃がすな！

English.Text: Enemy contact. We mustn't let them escape!

Text: 見事な回避だ！

English.Text: Nicely done!

Text: 敵の動きが　よく見えているな

English.Text: They can't get the drop on you!

Text: いいぞ　敵を翻弄してやれ！

English.Text: Good! Show them what we're made of!

Text: よくやった　その調子で頼む！

English.Text: Great work! Keep it up, ranger!

Text: 全機撃墜だ　すごいじゃないか！

English.Text: All enemies eliminated! Incredible!

Text: すばらしい命中率だ！

English.Text: That was some fine shooting!

Text: 敵部隊の殲滅を確認　次の襲撃に備えろ！

English.Text: No other enemy contacts detected. Prepare for the next wave!

Text: 君の活躍には　目を見張るものがあるな

English.Text: Very well done! I daresay you've earned yourself a medal!

Text: よーし　敵の戦力を大幅に削ったな！

English.Text: Bravo! You've dealt a heavy blow to the enemy!

Text: 勝利は目前だ　必ず勝って帰るぞ！

English.Text: Victory is within reach! Now go and seize it!

Text: 宇宙は広く美しい　我々の手で守らねばな

English.Text: Behold the majesty of our galaxy! This is what we fight for!

Text: 大丈夫か！

English.Text: Careful!

Text: 相手の動きを　よく見ろ！

English.Text: You gotta focus, ranger!

Text: 持ち直せるか？

English.Text: Hang in there!

Text: 機体の損耗が激しい　回復を急げ！

English.Text: You've sustained heavy damage. Heal up now!

Text:
ダメージが蓄積している
このままだとやられるぞ！

English.Text: You're barely holding on, ranger! You won't last much longer!

Text:
エネルギー切れだな
チャージ完了まで持ちこたえろ！

English.Text: Energy reserves depleted. Hold tight until they've recharged!

Text:
エネルギー消費が激しい攻撃は
使いどころを見極めろ

English.Text: You mustn't burn through your energy reserves unless absolutely necessary!

Text: あれは　敵のエンキドゥ級戦艦！

English.Text: That's...an Enkidu-class warship!

Text: 最新鋭の魔晄ビーム砲搭載機だ　ぬかるなよ

English.Text: Be advised─it's equipped with state-of-the-art mako weaponry.

Text: 後方から　敵母艦接近！

English.Text: Mother ship closing in!

Text:
ギルガメッシュ軍の本隊だ
必ず仕留めるぞ！

English.Text: This is why we're here. Take it out at all costs!

Text: 勇気ある者は　私に続け！

English.Text: Space rangers! Follow my lead!

Text: まずは敵の戦力を削ぐ　砲台を狙え！

English.Text: We must reduce their firepower! Disable the cannons!

Text: 砲台の各個撃破に集中しろ！

English.Text: Focus on taking out those cannons!

Text:
逃がすな
背後から狙うぞ　私に続け！

English.Text: With me, rangers! We can't allow them to make their escape!

Text:
動力部を叩く
誘爆させて　一気に沈めるぞ！

English.Text: Concentrate your fire on the engines to destroy the mother ship!

Text:
巨大な戦艦も　動力を失えば自滅する
攻撃の手を緩めるな！

English.Text: The bigger they are, the harder they fall! Keep attacking those engines and we'll win!

Text: 総員退避　私の背後につけ！

English.Text: ...All ships, pull back! Get behind me!

Text: 私がしのぐ　うしろにまわれ！

English.Text: I'll keep them busy! Retreat!

Text: やられはしない！

English.Text: Hold the line!

Text: 衝撃に備えろ！

English.Text: Brace for impact!

Text:
君のおかげで　宇宙の平和は守られた
宇宙騎士団に栄光あれ！

English.Text: Well done, ranger! With your help, we have at long last restored peace to our galaxy!

Text:
ギルガメッシュ軍の脅威は去った
君こそ　宇宙騎士団の英雄だ！

English.Text: The Gilgamesh Army will trouble us no more. Your deeds this day will go down in history!

Text:
おのれ　ギルガメッシュ軍め！
宇宙に平和のあらんことを……

English.Text: No! How...can this be!? Curse you...Gilgamesh!

Text: かくれんぼか　バレット？

English.Text: Come on out!

Text: 相変わらず逃げてばっかだな　おまえは！

English.Text: There he goes again, our fearless friend!

Text: 俺を助けんじゃねえのかよ！

English.Text: I thought you were here to help me!

Text:
昔よくネズミ捕りをしたっけな
おまえ　間違って罠にかかったろ

English.Text:
'Member when we had that rat problem?
You and me set traps, and you
got caught in one of 'em.

Text: あの時は笑ったぜ　アハハハってなあ！

English.Text: I guess old habits die hard.

Text: よそ見してんじゃねえぞ！

English.Text: Better watch where you're lookin'!

Text: 遊びは終わりだ

English.Text: Nowhere to run.

Text: せいぜい　怯えるんだな

English.Text: Bet you're shakin' in your boots.

Text: 俺を見ろ　バレット！

English.Text: Look at me when I'm talkin'!

Text: バレットオオオ！

English.Text: I'm gonna kill you!

Text: どうしちまったんだよ　ダイン！

English.Text: What've you done to yourself, man!?

Text: ダイン　いま助けてやる

English.Text: It's okay, Dyne... You're gonna be okay!

Text: コックピットエラー発生

English.Text: Input error detected.

Text: 搭乗者は　至急対処してください

English.Text: Immediate correction strongly advised.

Text: うひょ？　え～っとえっと……

English.Text: Oops! Uh, let's see now...

Text: これかな　これかな？

English.Text: Was it this button, or...?

Text: うひょ　わしピ～ンチ！

English.Text: That's not good!

Text: うひょ　なんか踏んだ？

English.Text: Did I...step on something?

Text: うひょ～　結果オ～ライ！

English.Text: I'm on a roll!

Text: もしかして　わし　うまい？

English.Text: Well, look at that! I'm a natural!

Text: ワザとだもんね！

English.Text: I did that on purpose!

Text: おほほほ　やったやった！

English.Text: That's what you get!

Text: 後悔させてやる

English.Text: You're gonna regret that.

Text: うわ～　腹立つ～！

English.Text: Okay, I've had it up to here with you!

Text: イラっとしちゃった

English.Text: That does it!

Text: 舐められたものだ

English.Text: How dare you.

Text: ム～カ～ツ～ク～！

English.Text: Oh, this guy is pissin' me off!

Text:
ワーニング　出力１２０パーセント
脚部への負荷が増大中

English.Text:
Warning: exceeding maximum rated
output. Risk of limb failure high.

Text: さっさと片付ければ　問題な～し！

English.Text:
Nothing to worry about
if I finish this quickly!

Text:
両脚部の損傷を確認
コントロール不能　転倒に注意してください

English.Text:
Heavy damage sustained. Limbs
inoperable. Brace for potential rollover.

Text: ゲコゲコ～？

English.Text: Oh dear, oh dear me...

Text: 欲しいものは奪う　それがグリードよ

English.Text: You want something, you take it. That's just the way of the world.

Text:
なんだコラ
見せモンじゃねえぞ

English.Text: What, what!? You got a problem, asshole?

Text: また　馬鹿がカモられにきやがった

English.Text: Get a load of pretty boy here.

Text: いいナリしてんじゃねえか

English.Text: You look like you got gil to spare.

Text: くそ　ケツまでじゃりじゃりだぜ

English.Text: I swear, all this sand up my ass...

Text:
コルネオの野郎が消えて
ブツが　余ってるようです

English.Text: Yeah, there's plenty to go around now that Corneo's in the wind.

Text: あら　迷子かしら？

English.Text: Hey, honey. You lost?

Text: へえ　面白いじゃないか

English.Text: Sounds like easy pickin's.

Text:
ゴールドソーサー潜入チャレンジ
またも失敗……

English.Text: I'll get into that golden paradise one of these days, I swear!

Text:
次は　キグルミを着て
忍びこんでみよっかな？

English.Text: Oh! Maybe if I got my hands on a moogle costume...

Text: ここはクズの見本市さ

English.Text: Welcome to society's trash heap.

Text: プリズンオークションへ　ようこそ

English.Text: Welcome one and all!

Text:
本日も　選りすぐりの商品を
取りそろえております

English.Text: We've got a fine selection for today's auction.

Text: ぜひ　お買い逃がしのないように

English.Text: You're not gonna wanna miss out on these goods!

Text:
それでは　まずは
１０００ギルから始めましょう

English.Text: The bid for our first lot starts at a thousand gil!

Text:
皆様　暑い中
よくいらっしゃいました

English.Text: We thank you for joining us on this sweltering day.

Text:
本日の商品も
すべて　ゲス様からの贈り物です

English.Text: As usual, everything here was kindly provided by the boss.

Text:
ボスに感謝しつつ
競りを始めていきましょう

English.Text: So let's show our gratitude with some sky high bids!

Text:
では　最初の商品は
１０００ギルからスタートです

English.Text: This first lot'll be opening at one thousand gil!
Fifteen hundred!

Text:
痛い目にあわないうちに
出ていきな

English.Text: If you value your life, get out.
Two k!
Four k!
Eighteen hundred!

Text: 俺は３０００だ

English.Text: Three thousand!
Five thousand!
Thirteen hundred!

Text: ３０００でどうだ

English.Text: Three k here!
Forty-five hundred!

Text: さあ　ほかにいらっしゃいませんか？

English.Text: I know that's not all you folks got!

Text:
早くしないと
落札してしまいますよ？

English.Text: Better speak up fast or you're gonna miss your shot!

Text: あんた　目をつけられてるよ

English.Text: You're drawing a lot of attention.

Text: いいですか皆様　後悔しませんか？

English.Text: Don't want anyone leavin' here with regrets, now do we?
I'll go fifty-three hundred!

Text: こっちは７０００よ

English.Text: Seven thousand!

Text: ９０００でどうだ

English.Text: Nine thousand!
Six thousand!
Seventy-five!

Text: もう　８０００ギルよ！

English.Text: Argh─ Eight thousand!
Dammit. Five and five!

Text: 俺は７７００だ

English.Text: Seventy-seven hundred!

Text: じゃあ　８８００よ

English.Text: Eight thousand eight hundred!

Text:
プリズンなんて言われてるけど
いいとこだろ？

English.Text: Not half bad for a prison, am I right?

Text: ちくしょう　１００００だ！

English.Text: Aw, dammit! Ten thousand!

Text:
１２０００！
これ以上はねえだろ

English.Text: Twelve thousand! Ain't no one goin' higher!

Text:
２５０００！
絶対　渡さねえぞ

English.Text: Twenty-five k! Try beating that, y'all!
Ten thousand! You heard me!

Text: １３０００　これが限界よ！

English.Text: Thirteen thousand! I know y'all ain't got more!

Text:
２００００
もう　どうにでもなれ！

English.Text: To hell with it! Twenty thousand!

Text: ほかにいませんね

English.Text: Any other bids?

Text: では　落札です！

English.Text: Then it's sold!

Text:
これは　もういらっしゃらないでしょう
おめでとうございます　落札です！

English.Text: Going once, going twice...and sold! Congratulations.

Text: すばらしい　見事落札です！

English.Text: Sold! Better luck next time, folks.

Text: それでは　次へいきましょう

English.Text: Moving on to our next lot...

Text:
こちらの商品も
１０００ギルからスタートです

English.Text: We'll start the bidding at a thousand gil again.

Text:
続きまして　新しい商品です
こちらも１０００ギルからいきましょう

English.Text: And for the next lot, we have this lovely piece. I'm looking for a thousand gil.

Text:
では続いての商品です
皆様　準備はよろしいでしょうか

English.Text: Are y'all ready for this next one? I hope so, 'cause it is one dazzlin' piece of work!

Text: １０００ギルからスタートです

English.Text: Do I hear a thousand?

Text: 金持ち連中の顔を覚えとけよ

English.Text: Pay attention. Remember their faces.

Text: おっ　やんのか？

English.Text: "Private meetup"?

Text:
金が余ってるみたいだからな
いただいちまおうぜ

English.Text: Hey, if these folks wanna piss away all their gil, I say we help 'em.

Text: 連中が競り勝ったブツを盗めねえかな

English.Text: Think we can help ourselves to the "goods" too?

Text:
なるほど　そんでまた
その盗品を――

English.Text: That's a fine idea. Then we can take 'em right back here and...

Text: オークションに出すってワケだ

English.Text: Put 'em up for auction!

Text: 出せ　出してくれ！

English.Text: Please, you gotta get me outta here!

Text: 金なら　盗んででも用意する！

English.Text: If it's gil you want, I know about a big score!

Text: 妻は　妻は無事なんだろうな？

English.Text: Is my wife alright? Is she? I need to know!

Text:
なんでもいい
食べ物をくれないか

English.Text: I'm so hungry... I'll take anything...

Text: 俺は　だまされただけなんだよ！

English.Text: It ain't my fault! They made me do it!

Text: 終わりよ　なにもかも……

English.Text: Oh god, this is it. It's all over.

Text: ちょっと　あんた助けてよ！

English.Text: You! You have to help me! Please!

Text: やだ……やだ……

English.Text: No, no, no... This can't be happening!

Text: 助けて　なんでもするから！

English.Text: Get me outta here. I'm begging you!

Text: みず……水をちょうだい

English.Text: Water... Just a few drops of water...

Text:
静かにしろ！
ったく　うるさいヤツらだ

English.Text: Put a sock in it! C'mon...

Text:
ゲヘヘ　こいつらを見るのが
楽しくてさあ

English.Text: Hehehe! Piss and moan some more, why don'tcha!

Text:
心配すんな　悪いようにはしねえからよ
まあ　イイようにもしねえがな

English.Text: Don't you worry, we ain't gonna hurt ya. Promise. Though that's the least of your troubles.

Text:
あと３日の我慢だ　いや４日だったか？
まあ　とにかく我慢だ

English.Text: All you gotta do is tough it out for three more days. Or was it four? Eh, it'll fly by.

Text:
しっかり反省するんだね
反省したところで　出られないけどね

English.Text: Should take this time to think about the choices that brung you here. Not that it'll help you get out.

Text:
ピーチクパーチクうるさいよ
いくら叫んでも　助けは来ないよ

English.Text: Knock it off with all that whining! No one's comin' for ya, so just shut the hell up!

Text: ゲス様の命令で　みんな釈放したよ

English.Text: Had to cut 'em all loose. Solemn Gus's orders.

Text: クソ　つまんねえな

English.Text: Shit. What am I s'posed to do now?

Text: ああ～　ヒマだ

English.Text: Thanks for puttin' me out of a job.

Text:
人を商品にするのはやめるってさ
俺は　賛成だよ

English.Text: Just between you and me, I'm one hundred percent behind letting everyone go.

Text:
なんだい？
アタシらは反省なんてしないよ

English.Text: What? You think I feel bad for makin' money?

Text: 釈放はゲス様の命令だ　仕方ないね

English.Text: No room for argument when it's a direct order from the boss man himself.

Text: お兄さん　いまヒマ？

English.Text: Hey! Lookin' for a way to kill time?

Text: う～ん　お金は持ってなさそうだね

English.Text: Don't have a gil to your name, do you?

Text:
キレイな顔
ねえ　いっしょに働かない？

English.Text: Careful now. Handsome face like yours is bound to draw some attention.

Text: うん　遊んでく？

English.Text: So... You come here often?

Text:
ゴールドソーサーでは味わえないこと
したくない？

English.Text: Screw the Saucer. Down here's where the real fun happens.

Text: なに見てんの　お金とるわよ

English.Text: Take a picture, pal. It'll last longer.

Text:
ヒャッハー！
ならず者の楽園へ　ようこそ

English.Text: Hah! Welcome to the outlaws' paradise!

Text:
へへへ　俺たちグリードが
丁重におもてなしするぜ！

English.Text: We'll be sure to give y'all the royal treatment! Hahaha!

Text:
金はあるか　腕っぷしに自信はあるか？
ないならいますぐ帰んな

English.Text: Well? You got gil or you got skills? Gonna need one or the other if you wanna survive down here!

Text: グリードの街へ　よく来やがった

English.Text: Best watch your step when you're on our turf!

Text:
死にたくなけりゃ
俺たちのルールに従うんだな

English.Text: We're the law around here, so don't piss us off if you wanna see tomorrow!

Text: ヒャッホー！

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Text:
コレルプリズンによく来たな　ベイビー
ここは地獄よりもヘビーな楽園だぜ

English.Text: So nice of you to drop in on us down here! Just so you get an idea of where you're at, hell's got nothing on this place.

Text:
お遊びのつもりなら
ママのところに帰んな

English.Text: If you're lookin' for an easy time, best go crawlin' back to mommy.

Text: あは　あははは……

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Text: ほら見て　新しい人が来たよぉ

English.Text: Ooh, lookie here! New guy.

Text:
あはははは　すご～い
チョコボ人間だぁ

English.Text: Hehe... Wow! Never seen a chocobo-man before.

Text:
新しい世界に新しい人
最高だわぁ

English.Text: New world with new people and...new people things!

Text: こんにちはぁ　チョコボ人間さん

English.Text: Hey, it's the chocobo-man. Wassup?

Text:
そうだ　チョコボ人間さんに
エサをあげなきゃ

English.Text: Hey, choco-man! C'mere! I got some feed for you.

Text: あは　あはははは

English.Text: Hahaha!

Text:
うふ　うふふふふ
どうぞぉ？

English.Text: Hahaha! Dig in!

Text: かあーっ　やっぱキくな

English.Text: Woo! That hits the spot.

Text:
なにが入ってんのか
わかんねえのが　最高だよな

English.Text: I dunno what's in it, but damn does it taste good.

Text:
へへへ　今日はアタリだぜ
頭がクラクラしやがる

English.Text: Hehe! Yeah, it's good shit! Goes down smooth and warms ya up quick.

Text: だあ～　熱くなってきやがった

English.Text: I'm just gettin' started!

Text:
そうか？　オレは
なんか寒くなってきた

English.Text: Yeah? Well, uh... I think I'm gonna call it.

Text: オレは　気持ち悪くなってきた……

English.Text: Hrng... I ain't...feelin' so good.

Text: この酒　なにが入ってんだ？

English.Text: Seriously, what the hell's in this?

Text:
いいか新入り
金だ　なにごとも金

English.Text: Listen up, shithead. Round here, it's all about that gil.

Text:
ここじゃ　お金がないと
安全も買えないの　わかった？

English.Text: If you can't pay your dues, then you're as good as dead. Got me?

Text:
わっ　わかったから
もう殴らないでくれ！

English.Text: I got it. Just don't hit me anymore!

Text:
うふふ　でも
痛い目をみないと覚えないでしょ？

English.Text: Pain makes the lesson stick. We're doing you a favor.

Text:
よかったじゃねえか
これでひとつ賢くなったろ

English.Text: Bet you're glad we learned you real good. Ain'tcha, bitch?

Text:
それじゃあ
安全を金で買ってもらおうか

English.Text: This is the part where you pay me if you wanna stay my new best friend.

Text: かっ　金はないんだ

English.Text: But...I don't got any gil!

Text:
大丈夫　心配しないで
お金を作る方法なら色々あるから

English.Text: Don't you worry your pretty little head about that. There are plenty of ways to earn your keep around here.

Text: 姐さん　次のヤマですが――

English.Text: So, Boss, about our next job...

Text: しっ　声を落としな

English.Text: Shh! Keep it down, idiot.

Text:
ミッドガルからの
横流し品を狙います

English.Text: Could hit a shipment of black market goods out of Midgar.

Text: 金　落ちてねえか？

English.Text: Keep a close watch on your wallet.

Text:
オレ　砂漠の砂を
売ろうと思ってんだ

English.Text: They say you can sell sand with the right spin, but...

Text: クソ　また値上がりしてやがる

English.Text: Goddammit! Another price hike!?

Text: ったく　ロクなもんがねえな

English.Text: There anything here that ain't shit?

Text:
いちどでいいから
上で買い物したいな

English.Text: I'd love to check out the shops up top at least once.

Text:
今日は水だけ
お酒は買わない　絶対

English.Text: Just water today. No alcohol. No sir.

Text: 砂漠の巣穴へようこそ　兄弟

English.Text: Lookin' for a place to hole up? You found it.

Text: 独房のように　ぐっすり眠れるぜ

English.Text: Quiet as solitary─guaranteed.

Text: またいつでも来な　兄弟

English.Text: Feel free to drop by any time.

Text: いい監獄ライフを　兄弟

English.Text: Enjoy your stay in hell, brother.

Text:
ねえ　そこのお兄さんに
話しかけてみない？

English.Text: Hey, how 'bout that handsome fella over there?

Text:
はあ　おまえってホント
面食いだな

English.Text: You know there's more to people than just looks.

Text: 顔がイイに越したことないでしょ

English.Text: But appearance still counts for a lot.

Text:
あのね　そうやって選り好みするから
ノルマを達成できないのよ

English.Text: And this is why you never make your quota. You need to stop being so damn picky.

Text: おい　砂が入ってんぞ？

English.Text: Hey! There's sand in my drink!

Text:
相変わらず　ウスいな！
ここの酒はよ

English.Text: Dunno why I bother. This stuff's more water than booze.

Text:
いくら飲んでも酔えねえ
どうなってんだ

English.Text: What the hell's a guy gotta do to get shit-faced around here!?

Text: クソ　有り金ぜんぶスっちまった

English.Text: Son of a bitch... Musta been pickpocketed.

Text:
ひっく……
サボテン酒の砂割り持ってこい！

English.Text: Shot of cactuar rum, and cut it with some sand!

Text:
あれ……？
あれ　財布がない！

English.Text: Huh? Shit! My wallet's gone!

Text:
フワフワするぅ
飛んでるみたぁ～い

English.Text: Hahaha, I'm flying! I'm flying!

Text:
知ってる？　神羅の酒って
魔晄の味がすんの

English.Text: Ever wonder what mako tastes like? Take a swig of Shinra booze and you'll know.

Text:
おえ　このカクテル
下水でも入ってんの？

English.Text: Gross! Was this cocktail cut with sewage!?

Text:
まあ　いいか
どうせ１ギルも入ってなかったし

English.Text: Eh. Not like it had anythin' in it anyway.

Text:
うふふ
ボーッとしてるからすられるのさ

English.Text: That's what you get for spacin' out.

Text:
さて　本日の収穫は……って
１ギルも入ってないじゃないの！

English.Text: Now, what'd I score today? Huh!? There isn't even a single gil in here!

Text:
飲んだくれの酒場
ベイル・ジャンパーへようこそオマエら
行くぜ！

English.Text: Welcome to Bail Jumper, where all the good boys and girls go to drink 'emselves blind! Kick it!

Text:
神羅もゴールドソーサーもクソくらえ
監獄から　世界を変えるぞ！

English.Text: Shinra and the Gold Saucer can eat our shit! This hellhole's ours─and so's the world!

Text:
今日も　盗んだギターを
かき鳴らしにきたぜ？

English.Text: We stole their guitars to bring the people our sweet music.

Text: 盛りあがっていけよ　オマエら！

English.Text: Y'all ready to make some noise!?

Text:
クソみたいな世界を
いっしょにブッつぶそうぜ！

English.Text: C'mon! We'll burn this mother down!

Text: 行くぜ　オマエら！

English.Text: Let's give 'em hell!

Text:
ワン　ツー
ワンツースリーフォー！

English.Text: One! Two! One two three four!

Text:
しっかり働いて
ゲス様にショバ代を払えよ

English.Text: Keep your noses to the grindstone, people! You better pray you're able to make rent!

Text: 滞納は許されねえからな

English.Text: 'Cause you'll be eatin' more than just late fees!

Text:
ゲス様のおかげで
安心して　店をやれてんだ

English.Text: Remember: it's thanks to Gus that y'all get to do your business in peace.

Text: ちゃんと感謝しねえとな

English.Text: So show him some gratitude!

Text:
悪さしてる奴はいねえか？
殴りたくて　ウズウズしてんだ

English.Text: Any y'all folks up to no good? 'Cause these fists of mine've been itchin' for a fight.

Text:
ルールを破った奴は出てこい
気持ちよく殴らせてくれる奴でもいいぞ

English.Text: Don't be shy now! I know some of y'all done some shit, so speak up! Don't make me start beatin' on people to get answers!

Text:
これが今月分
こっちは　先月分だ

English.Text: Here's this month's payment. And this is for last month.

Text: 確かに　あとは先々月の分だね

English.Text: I seem to recall you still owe us for the month before that too.

Text:
えっ　いや
それは払ったはずだが

English.Text: What? No, I'm sure I already paid that.

Text: いや　受け取った覚えはねえなあ

English.Text: Oh yeah? 'Cause I ain't got no memory of it.

Text: ばかな　ゲス様に確認してくれ

English.Text: Just check with Gus. I know he'll back me up.

Text:
なんだい
アタシたちを疑ってんのかい？

English.Text: Now hold on. You callin' me a liar?

Text: ったく滞納しといて　ひどい話だよ

English.Text: Man with your kinda debt oughta be more careful with his words.

Text:
てめえ　こっちはいつでも
値上げできるんだぞ？

English.Text: Keep talkin' like that and you might have to start payin' a premium.

Text: わかった……払うよ

English.Text: Alright, alright. I'll pay.

Text: 店で騒ぐヤツは　ぶっ飛ばす

English.Text: Make a peep and you're gone. That's a promise.

Text: シィー……　静寂がこの店のルールだ

English.Text: Shhh! Silence is sacrosanct.

Text: 武器は大切にな

English.Text: Take care of your weapons.

Text: 整備は欠かすなよ

English.Text: Don't skimp on gear.

Text: うるせえぞ！

English.Text: Shut up!

Text: ルール違反者には売らねえよ

English.Text: I don't sell to rulebreakers.

Text: とっとと　出てけ！

English.Text: Get your ass outta here!

Text: はん　油断したな

English.Text: I told you: be quiet or beat it!

Text: 絶対　音を立てんなよ

English.Text: Word of warning: don't make a peep.

Text: そ～っと　そ～っと……

English.Text: Careful now... Silent as the grave...

Text:
しっ　静かに
ぶっ飛ばされっぞ

English.Text: Shh! Be quiet. Else you'll get it.

Text: この店……緊張する

English.Text: This place and its rules, I swear...they terrify me!

Text: 足音に注意

English.Text: Whatever you do, do it quietly.

Text: 騒いだら　追い出されるわよ？

English.Text: You'll get tossed out if you make any kinda noise.

Text:
いらっしゃいませ
ワタシの　ワタシの店へようこそ

English.Text: Welcome to my humble establishment. Please─peruse the selection.

Text:
強くなりたいなら
ワタシの店に　おまかせを

English.Text: If you're looking to get stronger, my store has everything you'll need!

Text: また　ワタシの店に来てくださいね！

English.Text: My store will always be open to you!

Text: ワタシの店はどうでした　最高でしたよね？

English.Text: What do you think of my store? Be honest─it's the best you've ever seen, right?

Text: サボテン大王の新刊はどこだ

English.Text: Now, where's the latest issue of Cactuar King?

Text: ゲス様の自伝があるはずなんだが

English.Text: Gus's book should be around here somewhere...

Text:
これこれ！
ゲス様の『孤独のアウトロー』

English.Text: It's Gus's autobiography! Meditations on the Outlaw Life!

Text: 本を盗んでも　すぐバレんのよ

English.Text: Only steal a book if you're lookin' to get caught.

Text: いらっしゃい！

English.Text: Come on in!

Text:
ゲス様の自伝
『孤独のアウトロー』が入荷したよ

English.Text: Meditations on the Outlaw Life─Gus's autobiography─now in stock!

Text: グリードのボス　ゲス様の自伝だよ

English.Text: Read the only thing worth reading: your boss's book!

Text:
読んだだけで強くなれる
保証モンの名著だ

English.Text: The wisdom contained therein will give you the strength to take on the world!

Text:
ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』
買ってって！

English.Text: Buy Gus's Meditations or I'll stab the shit outta you till you do!

Text:
中身は単純明快！
文字はわずか　誰でも読める

English.Text: Don't read so good? Not a problem. Book's mostly pictures anyway.

Text:
ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』
よろしくね～！

English.Text: Take home Gus's Meditations on the Outlaw Life today!

Text:
なんで　グリードのオレが
宣伝してんだ！

English.Text: How the hell did I get roped into this bullshit?

Text:
みかじめ料を取りにきたら
店主に押しつけられて　このザマよ

English.Text: I just came to collect Gus's dues, not stand around hawkin' his damn book.

Text: うちはゲス様御用達の　チョコボショップだよ

English.Text: This here shop's got Gus's seal of approval.

Text: チョコボも　目立っていかないとね

English.Text: No one wants a run-of-the-mill chocobo.

Text: しっかりチョコボを　着飾ってやるんだね

English.Text: You have fun gussyin' up that bird of yours!

Text: ゲス様みたいに　ド派手にしてやんな

English.Text: Go on and make 'em as flashy as Gus.

Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: 'Sup.

Text: なんか用か

English.Text: Need something?

Text: じゃあな

English.Text: See ya.

Text: まいどあり

English.Text: Thanks.

Text: 毎回思うが　見事なもんだな

English.Text: I don't know how you make such masterpieces.

Text: そりゃどうも

English.Text: Thank you kindly.

Text:
アンタほどの職人が
なんで　こんなとこにいるんだ

English.Text: What's an artist like you doin' in a place like this, anyway?

Text:
べつに　ここだったら
自由に彫れるってだけさ

English.Text: Workin'. Free to live my life as I see fit here.

Text: なんか　やべえモンでも彫ったのか

English.Text: Craziest tat you ever did?

Text:
まあ　いろいろと
素っ裸のプレジデントとかね

English.Text: Oh, I don't know... Buck-naked President Shinra?

Text:
ハハハ　マジかよ
とんでもねえな！

English.Text: I almost wanna meet that man!

Text: ほら　笑うとズレるよ

English.Text: Don't laugh or it'll look like shit.

Text:
ひとつ　教えておいてやるぜ
ここの砂漠は超危険だぜ？

English.Text: Word of advice if you're thinkin' of goin' out there: don't. Desert's a death trap.

Text:
まずは　砂嵐！
巻き込まれたら右も左もわからねえ

English.Text: First you got your sandstorms. Get hit by one of those and you won't know up from down.

Text: あとは迷子になって干からびるだけよ

English.Text: May as well say your prayers and wait for the end.

Text:
そして　流砂！
いっぽ足を踏み入れたら最後
あとはなにもできずゆっくり沈むだけよ

English.Text: Then there's quicksand. Stumble into that and kiss the sky goodbye as you count the seconds till you say hello to a slow, painful demise.

Text: せいぜい　気をつけるこった

English.Text: Wouldn't wish that on no one.

Text:
まあ　どんだけ気をつけようが
死ぬときは死ぬけどな

English.Text: Though even if you avoid both those hazards, the desert'll find another way to get ya.

Text:
兄ちゃん
身ぐるみ剥がされんなよ

English.Text: Be careful not to lose it all. Like me.

Text:
クソ　あんなの
イカサマに決まってる！

English.Text: Dammit! Anyone with eyes could see they were cheatin'!

Text:
ひっひっひ
今夜はうまい酒が飲めそうだ

English.Text: Heh heh heh... I'm gonna be drinkin' good tonight!

Text: 俺の全財産が……

English.Text: That was everything I had to my name...

Text:
なあ　金を貸してくれ
ぜったい取り返すからよ

English.Text: Hey there, buddy. Got any gil to spare? I promise I'll pay you back.

Text:
おい　上に密告すんじゃねぞ
捕まっちまうからな

English.Text: Don't even think about snitchin'. 'Less you feel like diggin' your own grave.

Text: さて　次は誰をカモろうかね

English.Text: Now then... Which lucky idiot's gonna be my next mark?

Text:
お金に困ってない？
うちは利息も安いわよ

English.Text: Strapped for gil, honey? We've got the lowest interest rates around.

Text: 引き際を見失ったら終わりさ

English.Text: Miss your chance to throw in your cards, and it's over.

Text:
素人が手を出すんじゃないよ
捕まりたくないだろ？

English.Text: This place ain't for amateurs, so unless you wanna piss your money away─beat it.

Text: 見たぞ　すげえパーティーだったな

English.Text: You see that!? What a show, man!

Text:
まさか　ジョーカーを
倒しちまうなんて

English.Text: Where are the screams? The precious screams of pain!?

Text: すげえ　やっちまったのかよ！

English.Text: That was the shit! You're a stone-cold killer!

Text: マジかよ　生きて帰ったか

English.Text: How did you survive that? What are you?

Text: ジョーカーをいじめやがって

English.Text: How dare you, you...bully!

Text: ヒュ～　盛りあがったな！

English.Text: Ain't never seen anything that intense!

Text: ゲスパーティー　最高！

English.Text: Now that was quality entertainment!

Text:
おまえ　ビーストバトルグラウンドに
出たんだって？

English.Text: You fought in the Beast Battleground? You're crazy!

Text: あ～ん　ゾクゾクしたわ

English.Text: Oh, that was thrilling!

Text: 最高のパーティー！

English.Text: How the hell did you do that!?

Text:
キャーーー！
あたしの応援　聞こえた？

English.Text: Didja hear me cheerin' you on!? Didja!?

Text:
あんた　やるわね
アタシとやらない？

English.Text: You're not half bad. Wanna tussle with me next?

Text:
フォーウ
ゲスパーティー最高！

English.Text:
Woo!
More! I wanna see more!

Text: フォーフォーフォーウ！

English.Text: Woo-ha-hoo!

Text:
まあな　あばらがイッちまったが
なんとか生きて帰ってきたよ

English.Text: It was nothin'. May've busted a rib, but I made it back in one piece.

Text: 挑戦するだけでもすげえよ　尊敬する

English.Text: That's still impressive, man. For real─respect.

Text:
水をさして悪いが　そいつ
死んだフリして踏まれただけだぞ

English.Text: Hate to break it to you, but all dumbass here did was play dead while the monsters trampled him.

Text:
おまえ　ゲスパーティーに出るって
ホントか？

English.Text: You seriously sign up for the boss's challenge?

Text:
ああ　ずっと挑戦したいって
思ってたんだ

English.Text: Bet your ass I did. Always wanted to put my skills to the test.

Text: すっげえなあ

English.Text: Damn, man. You're somethin' else.

Text:
でもよ　ゲスパーティーって
５人組じゃないとダメだろ？

English.Text: Wait, but...don't you need a group of five people to compete? Who else you got?

Text: そうなのか？

English.Text: Whoa...really?

Text:
クソ　せっかくジョーカーと戦えると
思ったけど　あきらめるしかないか

English.Text: Damn. I had no idea you couldn't fight solo. Was looking forward to showin' off, but rules are rules.

Text: 俺が５人　集めてやろうか

English.Text: I'll round up some guys for you!

Text:
大丈夫　大丈夫！
すご～く残念だけどあきらめるよ

English.Text: Nah, s'all good! Don't wanna risk anyone else's lives, you know?

Text: あいつら　強すぎてやる気しねえ

English.Text: They're so far outta my league. Ain't no point in playing.

Text: 流れ者のバウターらしいな

English.Text: Never heard of travelin' card sharks.

Text: 誰かヤツらを負かしてくれねえかな

English.Text: Can't anyone beat these cheats for us?

Text: つまんないな～

English.Text: This ain't even a contest.

Text: あいつら　早く帰ってくれないかな

English.Text: Wish they'd hurry up and move on already.

Text:
強すぎると
賭けが成立しないのよね

English.Text: What's the point if you already know who's gonna win? This is bullshit.

Text:
今日は　どんなヤツが
血祭りになるかな～！

English.Text: I can't wait to see who gets ripped to shreds today!

Text:
悲鳴を聞いてると
心が安らぐんだよな

English.Text: Nothing soothes the soul quite like howls of agony.

Text:
ここで育成されたモンスターを買いに
世界中から　バイヤーが集まるって話だ

English.Text: Buyers from all over come here for our monsters. These murder babies are the best of the best.

Text:
ハハ　やっちまえ
やられちまえ！

English.Text: Hahaha! Get 'im! Tear his head off!

Text:
アタシ　モンスターの飼育員を
目指してんの

English.Text: It's my dream to be a caretaker of monsters.

Text: さあ　アンタの悲鳴を聞かせてよ

English.Text: I can't wait to hear what you sound like when you scream.

Text: 骨は拾ってやるよ　残ってたらね

English.Text: I'll take good care of your bones. If there's any left!

Text: ゲスパーティー　イイぃ！

English.Text: Yeah, bring it! I wanna see some blood!

Text: フォウ！

English.Text: Woo hoo!

Text: ジョーカーを味わいな

English.Text: This asshole doesn't stand a chance!

Text: ゲスパーティーへ　ようこそ！

English.Text: Oh, you're in for it now, shithead!

Text: フォウ！

English.Text: Woo hoo!

Text: アハハハ　がんばってね！

English.Text: Ahahaha! Good luck!

Text: ヒャッハー！

English.Text: Yee-haw!

Text: どけどけ！

English.Text: Outta the way!

Text: イヤッホー！

English.Text: Woohoo!

Text: 気持ちイイ～！

English.Text: Yeah! Be the wind!

Text:
どうよ　このモンスターマシン
３年かけて改造した自慢の逸品よ

English.Text: Check it! I've spent three years working on this baby, and now she's complete! Sweet, huh?

Text: かっけ～！

English.Text: Goddamn!

Text:
そんなのに乗ってる
アンタの気がしれないよ

English.Text: I can't believe you actually ride that thing in public.

Text: なんだ　うらやましいのか？

English.Text: Sounds like someone's jealous.

Text:
大切なのは見た目じゃなくて
稼げるかどうかだよ

English.Text: Doesn't matter how sweet it is if it doesn't get you paid, you know.

Text: それは　男もバイクもいっしょ

English.Text: Like a looker who can't hold down a job.

Text:
見てくれよ
神羅の純正パーツを手に入れてよ！

English.Text: Take a look at this! It's got that official Shinra logo and everything.

Text:
おいバカ　隠せ！
盗まれちまうぞ

English.Text: Gah! Put that shit away! You wanna get rolled?

Text: そうビビんなって

English.Text: Man, you worry too much.

Text:
いや～　ゲス様に
高い金払った甲斐があったぜ！

English.Text: I paid Gus a fortune for this. You know I gotta flaunt it!

Text:
んで　そのパーツを使うバイクは
どこだよ？

English.Text: So...you gonna put it on your bike or what?

Text:
バイクは盗まれちまった
ううう……

English.Text: My...my pride and joy...someone took her!

Text: やんのか！

English.Text: You wanna go!?

Text: やんのか？

English.Text: Just try it!

Text: やん……のか……

English.Text: You...you wanna go...?

Text: やん……のか……？

English.Text: Just...just try it...

Text:
ゲス様バンザーイ！
ここは　プリズンの王
ゲス様の屋敷よ

English.Text: All hail Solemn Gus─king of Corel Prison! Show respect─or get wrecked!

Text:
屋敷の中では　礼儀正しくな
釘バットのサビになりたかねえだろ

English.Text: Listen up, assholes. Watch your manners inside the mansion─or else it's a rusty nail bat to the head for you!

Text: なにコソコソしてんだ　コラ？

English.Text: Whatchu doin'? Sneakin' around and shit?

Text: 勝手に歩きまわんなよ

English.Text: Don't let me catch you wanderin'.

Text:
あやしいマネしやがったら
わかってんだろうな？

English.Text: One false move and we'll be all over you like that!

Text: 目ざわりだよ　消えな

English.Text: Get outta my sight, shithead!

Text:
ぶっ飛ばされるまえに
出ていくんだね

English.Text: Either you leave on your own or we drag your ass outside.

Text: ウロチョロすんじゃないよ

English.Text: Hey! No loiterin'.

Text:
チョコボか　モーグリか
サボテンダーか……

English.Text: Maybe a chocobo? Or a moogle? Though I could go for a cactuar...

Text:
いっそ　トンベリ？
どっきりでモルボル？

English.Text: There's always the tonberry... Or a malboro for shock value.

Text:
『戦争上等』
『来やがれウータイ！』
『砂漠でピース』……

English.Text: "Make art, not war!" "Do your worst, Wutai!" "Corel belongs to the people!"

Text: う～ん　なんて描こうかな

English.Text: Nah, not feelin' it.

Text:
『ようこそ　反神羅連絡会』
とかでもいいかも！

English.Text: Oh, I've got it! How about "Saluting the SRC"?

Text:
いいよな　おまえらは野菜が食えて
ちょっとぐらい俺が食っても
バレねえよな？

English.Text: How come y'all get to eat veggies? It ain't fair. No one'll notice if I sneak a few, right?

Text:
砂あびって　気持ちいいのか？
俺もやってみようかな

English.Text: Do sand baths really feel that good? Maybe I should try it.

Text:
この毛並みなら　いけそうだね
次のレースは死んでも勝ちな

English.Text: Yeah, I'd say you're lookin' pretty good. Better win the next one even if it kills you.

Text:
世話なんて　適当でいいんだよ
情が移ると別れがつらくなっちまうだろ

English.Text: Best not to get too attached, y'know. Only makes it harder when the time comes to say goodbye.

Text:
チョコボの砂あびはね
体をキレイにするだけじゃなく
リラックス法でもあるんだ

English.Text: Dust baths aren't just for keeping chocobos clean; they also help them de-stress. Two birds with one bath!

Text: やっても　変わらないと思う？

English.Text: Think it doesn't make a difference?

Text:
でもね　やるのとやらないのとじゃ
ぜんぜん違うよ

English.Text: Well it does, believe me. Makes 'em into whole new birds!

Text:
なにより　羽で砂が舞う光景が
美しくてね

English.Text: The way they roll around, kicking up a giant cloud of sand...

Text: 君もいちど　見てみるといいよ

English.Text: I promise it'll take your breath away.

Text: おまえも飲むか？

English.Text: Care for a drink?

Text: 見ろよこの銃　すげえだろ

English.Text: Check my piece. Pretty sweet, right?

Text:
俺はチョコボレースより
ビーストバトルグラウンド派だね

English.Text: The chocobo races are all you. I'm more of a Beast Battleground guy.

Text: また　チョコボを盗んでこねえと

English.Text: Gotta steal another chocobo soon.

Text: 部屋を荒らすんじゃねえぞ

English.Text: Don't you go messin' up the place.

Text: ゲス様は仕事中よ

English.Text: Gus is busy at the moment.

Text: あら　遊びにきたの？

English.Text: Hey there, honey. Sit with us awhile.

Text: うふふ　新入りの洗礼は受けた？

English.Text: Have you gone through the initiation yet?

Text: 今月のみかじめ料はどうなってる

English.Text: Everyone pay their dues in full for the month?

Text:
とどこおりなく　滞納している店も
順次回収する予定です

English.Text: We're gonna do some rounds soon. Remind folks who've fallen behind.

Text:
３ヶ月以上滞納した店は
見せしめに　つぶせ

English.Text: Anyone more than three months in the hole─you make an example of 'em.

Text: 了解しました

English.Text: Yes, sir!

Text:
この子は『バルチャー』
ゲス様のお気に入りなの

English.Text: Gus has a thing for vultures─keeps 'em as pets.

Text:
砂漠の道案内が
この子の得意技なのよ

English.Text: They're trained to lead people lost in the desert to safety.

Text:
砂漠でこの子を見つけたら
ついていくといいよ

English.Text: If you spot one of 'em out in the sands, best follow it.

Text:
ああ　アタシもゲス様に
かわいがってもらいたいわ

English.Text: I wish Gus treated me half as good as he does his vultures.

Text:
ハゲタカのバルチャーなら
砂漠に飛んでったよ

English.Text: If you're lookin' for vultures, look to the desert skies.

Text:
砂漠であの子を見つけたら
ついていくといいよ

English.Text: And should you spot one while you're lost, follow it.

Text:
アタシも　あの子みたいに
得意技を探さなきゃね

English.Text: Talented things. Gotta learn me some skills like them.

Text: そこだ　行け行け行け！

English.Text: Yeah, you got 'em! Go, go!

Text: なにしてんだ　バカチョコボ！

English.Text: You call that runnin', you stupid bird!?

Text:
そこだそこ
殴れ　蹴れ　潰せ！

English.Text: Now's your chance! Punch 'em! Kick 'em! Crush 'em!

Text: なにしてんだい　突っ込むんだよ！

English.Text: What're you doin'!? Run, damn you!

Text: ほらそこ　嚙みつきな！

English.Text: C'mon, you can't just let 'em pass you like that!

Text:
ちょっと　野菜あげたのに
この恩知らず！

English.Text: I feed you greens and this is how you repay me!?

Text: 野菜の状態は　まずまずかな

English.Text: I s'pose the produce here ain't all bad...

Text:
グラスランドのとれたて野菜に比べると
しなびてるし　色味も悪いけど

English.Text: I mean, compared to the stuff folks're growin' out in the grasslands, it's downright dire.

Text: 砂漠で贅沢は言えないしね

English.Text: But hey─I ain't picky!

Text:
ねえ　知ってる？
砂漠では　チョコボに砂あびをさせるんだって

English.Text: People around the prison've been tellin' me they give their birds sand baths to get 'em clean.

Text:
ブラッシングの代わりなのかな？
今度　ピコにも試してみようかな

English.Text: Wonder if it's any better for 'em than a standard brush-down. Maybe I'll give it a try with Piko!

Text: これで　３つ目だね

English.Text: And that makes three!

Text:
ピコの体調も良くなってきてるし
そろそろ　レースで戦えるんじゃないかな

English.Text: Once Piko's had his fill, he'll be ready to hit the track and win us that race!

Text:
レース用のパーツって　どんなやつかな
やっぱり性能だけじゃなくて　見た目も大事だろ？

English.Text: You think the gear Esther's got is any good? Ideally, it'd give Piko an edge and be pleasing to the eye.

Text:
ひいき目に見ても　ピコってカッコイイからさ
ちゃんと似合うやつだったらいいんだけど

English.Text: Our boy's one handsome bird, y'know! We want equipment that'll accentuate his features!

Text: こんなレースで　つまずいてらんないよ

English.Text: You better take home that trophy, y'hear?

Text:
いつか　チョコボレースの最高峰
『ゴールドカップ』に出るんだ

English.Text: Today's victory'll be our steppin' stone to the big one─the Gold Cup!

Text:
だから　クラウドも
ちゃんと腕を磨いといてよ

English.Text: I know Piko's ready to win it all, but are you?

Text:
これで６つ目
野菜はもう　じゅうぶんだね

English.Text: Six is plenty. Piko'll get sluggish if he eats too much.

Text: エストのところへ戻ろう

English.Text: Let's check in with Esther.

Text:
ゲス様プレゼンツ
『デザートラッシュ』ができるのはここだけ！

English.Text: Mister Gus presents: the one, the only, Desert Rush!

Text:
いまなら　ハイスコアを叩き出したあなたに
貴重な新鮮野菜をプレゼント！

English.Text: For a limited time only, if you earn the high score, you'll get some rare greens!

Text: どう　やってかない？

English.Text: Step right up and give it a try!

Text: 『デザートラッシュ』に挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Play Desert Rush?

Text:
<color=yellow>【デザートラッシュ　ノーマルモード】</color>
挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Play a <color=yellow>standard</color> round of Desert Rush?

Text:
<color=yellow>【デザートラッシュ　ハードモード】</color>
挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Play a <color=yellow>challenging</color> round of Desert Rush?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: どちらのモードに挑戦しますか？

English.Text: Select a difficulty level.

Text: ノーマルモード

English.Text: Standard

Text: ハードモード

English.Text: Challenging

Text: 挑戦しない

English.Text: Never mind.

Text: ストレス発散に　デザートラッシュ！

English.Text: Let off some steam today with Desert Rush!

Text: 砂漠名物　デザートラッシュだよ！

English.Text: Don't miss out on the desert's famed pastime!

Text: やらなきゃそんそん　レッツ・トライ！

English.Text: Give it a try! You won't regret it!

Text: またのご利用　お待ちしてま～す！

English.Text: Have a good day! Hope to see you again.

Text: やりたくなったら　また来てね～

English.Text: Come back...if you want a challenge.

Text: ええ～　やらないんですか？

English.Text: Aw, don't tell me you're not interested!

Text:
ナイスラッシュです！
そんなあなたに　新鮮野菜をプレゼント

English.Text:
Great job out there!
Got some greens for you, as promised.

Text:
あら～　バッドラッシュですね～
新鮮野菜は　おあずけで～す

English.Text: Aw! Better luck next time. Guess I'll be hangin' onto these greens for now.

Text: グレートラッシュ　びっくりです！

English.Text: That was incredible! Took me by surprise.

Text:
すごい　お客さん
めちゃくちゃ才能ありますよ！

English.Text: Wow! You've got some real talent there.

Text: ナイスラッシュ　いい感じですね！

English.Text: Nice one! That was pretty good.

Text: 次はもっと　上を目指してみましょう！

English.Text: Heh, see if you can do even better next time!

Text: ざんね～ん　バッドラッシュです

English.Text: Sorry, but that wasn't nearly up to snuff.

Text: あら～　もっと練習したほうがいいですね～

English.Text: Ooh... Looks like someone needs more practice.

Text: おっ　いいカモ発見～！

English.Text: He looks promising.

Text: ククク　カモがまた来やがったぜ

English.Text: Look who's come waltzin' back!

Text: なんだ　迷子か？

English.Text: You lost or somethin'?

Text: 文句でもあんのか？

English.Text: What? Got a problem?

Text: おら　新人は前を歩け

English.Text: Oh, am I holding you up?

Text: 俺たちは　散歩してるだけだよな？

English.Text: We're just goin' for a little stroll. Ain't that right?

Text: へっへっへ　こいつらはお友達さ

English.Text: We're all good friends here!

Text: 俺たちのことは　気にすんなって

English.Text: Don't mind us. We ain't doin' nothin'.

Text: へっへっへっへ

English.Text: Hahaha!

Text: クククク……

English.Text: Hih hih hih...

Text: いひひひ！

English.Text: Heheh...

Text: ひゃひゃひゃ！

English.Text: Hahaha!

Text: ふふふふ……

English.Text: Heh heh heh...

Text: プリズンの流儀を教えてやらねえとな

English.Text: Allow us to show you how things work around here.

Text: 怖がんなよ　俺と遊ぼうぜ

English.Text: Aw, come on. I don't bite.

Text: 悪いようにはしねえからよ

English.Text: I ain't gonna hurt ya. Promise.

Text: 俺は　しつこいぜ～

English.Text: Sorry, but you're stuck with me now.

Text: 逃がさねえよ

English.Text: You ain't gettin' away.

Text: そっちじゃねえだろ～？

English.Text: Whatcha goin' that way for, man?

Text: どこ行くつもりだ～？

English.Text: Where d'you think you're goin'?

Text: そっちに用はねえぞ

English.Text: Nothin' interestin' over there.

Text: 人気のないとこへ行こうぜ

English.Text: Let's go somewhere more quiet.

Text: いいぞ　そっちだ

English.Text: Yeah, that's the way.

Text: そうだ　その先だ

English.Text: Uh-huh, keep goin'.

Text: ククク　もうすぐだ

English.Text: Hehehe... Not far now.

Text: ほ～ら　そのまま進め

English.Text: You got it. Just straight ahead.

Text: チッ　逃げやがった

English.Text: Dammit! He got away.

Text: クソ　ここで待つか

English.Text: Shit. Guess I'll wait here.

Text: 逃げられると思うなよ

English.Text: Don't think this means you're free to go.

Text: 戻ってきたな

English.Text: Look who's back.

Text: 待ってたぜ

English.Text: It's about time.

Text: さて　お散歩の再開だ

English.Text: Let's resume our "constitutional."

Text: とうちゃ～く！

English.Text: And here we are!

Text:
ここまで来れば
邪魔されずに　好き放題できるってワケよ

English.Text: Now we can have a nice, private talk without anyone buttin' in.

Text: なあ！

English.Text: Right!?

Text:
俺たちが　プリズンの流儀を教えてやるからよ
ありがたく思うんだな

English.Text: It's time you got a lesson in the way things work around here. Don't worry, you can thank us later!

Text:
もう　強いんだったら
最初に言ってくださいよ～

English.Text:
Y'know, you coulda just told us
you were out of our league!

Text:
いや～　こんな強い方と
お手合わせできて光栄だな～！

English.Text:
I mean, uh...thanks for the match!
It was a real learnin' experience.

Text: なあ　おまえら！

English.Text: Wasn't it, boys?

Text:
そうだ　よかったら　これ……
お近づきのしるしに　どうぞ！

English.Text:
Oh, right! We got somethin' special for ya.
A gift to remember us by. Here!

Text:
それじゃあ　目ざわりな俺たちは
すぐに消えますんで

English.Text:
And with that...
We'll hurry up and get out of your hair.

Text: なあ　おまえら！

English.Text: Right, boys!?

Text: このたびは　本当にすいませんでした～！

English.Text: Very sorry to have troubled ya. We won't do it again! Promise!

Text:
みなさん
詐欺師育成セミナーへようこそ

English.Text: Greetings, friends, and welcome to my swindling seminar.

Text:
本日は　私が培ってきましたノウハウを
包み隠さず　すべてお教えします

English.Text: Today, for the very first time, I'll be unveiling the art behind the con─teaching you the tricks of my trade.

Text:
だまされる人生はここまで
みなさんは　生まれ変わるのです

English.Text:
Gone are the days of getting duped!
Remove the wool over your eyes.

Text:
いっしょに
立派な詐欺師になりましょう

English.Text: And instead, join me in the fleecing!

Text:
詐欺師に大切なことがなにか
わかりますか？

English.Text: Let's get right to the heart of skillful swindling.

Text: もちろん　嘘をつくことです

English.Text: The key is to never tell the truth.

Text:
嘘をつくぐらい
簡単だと思われるかもしれません

English.Text: This may sound easy to some, but do not be fooled.

Text:
ところが　嘘とは実に奥深く
繊細なものなのです

English.Text: There is a depth to the art of deception. It is a skill you must hone.

Text:
そのことを　みなさんに
体験してもらおうと思います

English.Text: And what better way to learn than a little practical application?

Text: では　さっそく嘘をついてみましょう

English.Text: Now then, let us begin the exercise.

Text:
せっかくなら　どなたかに
嘘を見破ってもらいたいのですが……

English.Text: Ideally, I would ask a passerby to tell truth from falsehood...

Text: あなた　いいところに来ました！

English.Text: You, sir, have excellent timing.

Text:
我が　詐欺師育成セミナーの
お手伝いをしませんか？

English.Text:
I'm conducting a seminar
and would appreciate your help.

Text:
もちろん　タダとは言いません
とても貴重なプレゼントを差し上げますよ

English.Text: And as thanks for your assistance, rest assured you will be handsomely rewarded.

Text:
これから　受講生のみなさんに
話しかけてください

English.Text: All you need to do is speak with my lovely pupils here.

Text:
４人の嘘つきの中に
１人の『正直者』が混ざっています

English.Text:
Four of these folks are lying,
while one and only one is telling the truth.

Text: その正直者を当ててください

English.Text: Your job is to find the odd one out!

Text:
挑戦する際には手数料が掛かりますので
ご了承ください

English.Text:
There's also a small fee to participate,
but I'm sure you won't mind.

Text:
プリズンの酒場といえば　ベイル・ジャンパー！
『コスモキャニオン』が飲めるのは　あそこだけさ

English.Text: If you're looking for a place to get loaded, then look no further than Bail Jumper! It's the only bar that serves Cosmo Canyons!

Text:
酒場のベイル・ジャンパーって知ってるか？
混じりっけなしの高級酒を提供してくれるぜ

English.Text: Hey, you ever heard of a place called Bail Jumper? Got the finest booze around─pure as the driven snow! Not watered down one bit!

Text:
ベイル・ジャンパーっていう酒場に行ってみな
名物の『ウスザケ』が　やみつきになるぜ～

English.Text: You oughta drop by Bail Jumper sometime. Their house specialty─"Sunshine"─is like nothing you've ever tasted. Promise!

Text:
プリズンの酒場はいいぜえ
ウス～い酒が　たらふく飲めるからよ

English.Text: You know, the bars around here serve drinks so watered down that you can go for hours on end and still not feel it!

Text: うへへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh heh...

Text: うへへへ……

English.Text: Heh heh heh...

Text: ああ～？

English.Text: You got a problem?

Text: ああ～？

English.Text: Was it something I said?

Text:
おっ　いい飲みっぷりだね～
そいつは当店の名物『ウスザケ』よ

English.Text: Heh, you seem like a guy who can hold his liquor. That's our house specialty─call it "Sunshine."

Text: 限界までウスめられた　奥深い味が最高だろ？

English.Text: We take moonshine and water it down so the flavor's juuust still perceptible.

Text: 自慢の『ウスザケ』　結構イケるだろ

English.Text: You're hittin' that stuff pretty hard. Good thing it ain't too strong.

Text: うちの酒は　ウスくてうまいだろ？

English.Text: It may be diluted, but it's got a refined taste.

Text:
武器屋の店長　ああ見えて意外とドジなんだよね
だって　間違って『ポーション』を売ってるのよ

English.Text: The weapon store owner's got a few screws loose if you ask me. I mean, what's he doing selling potions of all things?

Text:
武器屋には行った？
騒がしい店だったでしょ

English.Text:
You been to the weapon shop?
It's ridiculously loud in there.

Text:
『ポーション』も売ってるから
私は癒やされたいときに行くの

English.Text:
I like it though─helps me relax.
Plus, they sell potions there too.

Text: プリズンの武器屋は　私語厳禁

English.Text: No talking allowed in the local weapon shop.

Text:
なぜか『エリクサー』が売ってるけど
びっくりして　物音を立てないようにね

English.Text: And that includes any shouts of surprise when you find out they sell elixirs too.

Text:
武器屋に『エリクサー』が売ってたから
驚いて声をあげたの　そしたら怒られちまった

English.Text: I gasped when I found out the weapon shop sold elixirs, which immediately got me kicked out for making noise.

Text: ふん……

English.Text: Hah...

Text: ふわ～……

English.Text: Hey, keep it movin'!

Text:
『孤独のアウトロー』が読みたいのによ
魔導書店に置いてねえんだよな

English.Text: I'm dying to read Gus's autobiography, Meditations on the Outlaw Life, but the bookstore still doesn't have it in stock.

Text:
魔導書店に　ブラザー・ガスの自伝
『舎弟のアウトロー』が入荷したんだってよ

English.Text: Ya gotta check out Garth's autobiography, Meditations on the Underling Life. It's at the local bookstore.

Text:
ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』は読んだか？
魔導書店に置いてあるから　覗いてみるんだな

English.Text: Have you read Gus's autobiography Meditations on the Outlaw Life yet? You can pick it up at the local bookstore. I definitely recommend it.

Text:
魔導書店に置いてあるロンリー・ゲス様の自伝
『孤独のアウトロー』は読んどいたほうがいいぜ

English.Text: You need to get yourself over to the local bookstore to nab a copy of Gus's autobiography, Meditations on the Outlaw Life. It's a must read, trust me!

Text: フヒャハッハ！

English.Text: Ahahaha!

Text: フォー！

English.Text: Woo!

Text:
おっと　お目が高い　そちらはいま話題の１冊
ロンリー・ゲス様の自伝『孤独のアウトロー』です

English.Text: Oh, you have an eye for fine literature. That's the first volume of Solemn Gus's best-selling autobiography, Meditations on the Outlaw Life.

Text:
孤独だったゲス少年が　なりあがり
プリズンを支配するまでのサクセスストーリー

English.Text: It's the tale of a lonely little boy who dreamed of running his very own prison.

Text:
キャッチコピーは
ゲスで上等　笑って生きろ！

English.Text: Like the tagline says, "There's a bit of Gus in all of us!"

Text:
読み終わると　前向きになる素晴らしい１冊ですよ
ぜひ　波乱万丈な人生を追体験してみてください

English.Text: You'd be a fool to miss this chance to partake of Gus's wisdom. By the time you've read to the end, you'll see the world in a whole new light.

Text:
ゲス様が書かれた『孤独のアウトロー』は
グリードの歴史書としても　オススメですよ！

English.Text: Solemn Gus's Meditations on the Outlaw Life paints a thrilling portrait of the criminal underworld.

Text:
あなたも『孤独のアウトロー』を読んで
破天荒な男になってみませんか～？

English.Text: Maybe his inspiring tale will motivate you to become an entrepreneurial hoodlum as well! Who knows?

Text:
ゲス様の屋敷ってラクガキだらけで可愛いでしょ？
特に『ハッピーテンダー』がキュートなんだよね～

English.Text: Gus's crib is covered in graffiti─like some kinda art museum. My personal favorite is this adorable del Sol cactuar!

Text:
ゲス様の屋敷のグラフィティは見た？
『ハッピーテンダー』が隠れてるから探してみて

English.Text: You checked out the graffiti at Gus's place? He's got a del Sol cactuar in there. See if you can find it.

Text:
ゲス様の屋敷の壁には
『忠犬スタンプ』が描いてあるの

English.Text: It's kinda weird, but Gus has a picture of Stamp on his wall.

Text: 躍動感があって　すごく可愛らしいんだよね

English.Text: I swear, it looks like it could jump out and start licking your face!

Text:
ゲス様の屋敷に描いてある
『忠犬スタンプ』　見た？

English.Text: Hey, did you see the Stamp graffiti over at Gus's crib?

Text: 可愛くて　いまにも飛び出してきそうだったでしょ

English.Text: He may be a pup, but he sure looks like a hero!

Text: えへへ

English.Text: Hahaha!

Text: うふふふ

English.Text: Uh-huh...

Text:
ビーストバトルグラウンドに挑戦してみな
『バグ０』って　レアなモンスターに会えるぜ

English.Text: You should test your might in the Beast Battleground. They've got a rare monster named Bug 0.

Text:
ビーストバトルグラウンドに行ってみたか？
『カロリー０』ってモンスターが強いんだよな

English.Text: Have you tried the Beast Battleground yet? I hear that Type-0 monster's a real toughie.

Text:
地下にあるビーストバトルグラウンドには
『テスト０』って名前のモンスターがいるんだと

English.Text: Dunno if you've heard, but there's a special monster named Test 0 in the Beast Battleground.

Text:
ビーストバトルグラウンドに出れば
『テスト０』っていうレアモンスターと戦えるぜ

English.Text: If you visit the Beast Battleground, you might just run into a rare monster named Test 0.

Text: ふふ～ん

English.Text: Heh heh...

Text: うっへへへー！

English.Text: Heh heh...

Text: どなたが正直者か　わかりましたか？

English.Text: Well? Do you think you can figure out who's telling the truth?

Text: どなたが正直者か　わかりましたか？

English.Text: Do you know who is telling the truth?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text:
手数料が足りませんね
何事にもお金は必要です　出直してください

English.Text: Hm? Sorry, friend, but you don't have enough gil. Money makes the world go round, you know─come back when you've got some.

Text: 嘘か真実か　街を調べて確認されてもいいですよ

English.Text: The truth is out there, as they say. I encourage you to walk around town and find it.

Text: <button=RS> 正直者を選ぼう

English.Text: <button=RS> Who is Telling the Truth?

Text: 酒浸りのウサン

English.Text: Thirsty Usain

Text: 百戦錬磨のトロイ

English.Text: Knucklehead Toya

Text: 悪書家のソウ

English.Text: Sloppy Shawn

Text: 近視眼のラホ

English.Text: Squinty Rachel

Text: 大言壮語のキョギ

English.Text: Blowhard Georgie

Text: う～ん残念　不正解です！

English.Text: Oh, too bad! I'm afraid you've been had.

Text:
みなさん　嘘がお上手ですねえ
すばらしい！

English.Text:
My pupils have a knack for the art of deception.
Well done!

Text:
では　シャッフルして　もういちどやりましょう
今度こそ　しっかりと見極めてくださいね

English.Text: Discerning the truth is a skill, just like telling a lie. Now then, what say we take it from the top and have you try again?

Text:
またまた不正解
はい　やり直し！

English.Text:
You've been hoodwinked once again!
Better luck next time, friend.

Text:
大正解です
なんという洞察力　すばらしい！

English.Text: Congratulations! Their deception was no match for your powers of perception!

Text:
みなさん　世の中には
こういう鋭い方がいらっしゃるのです

English.Text: Beware, my aspiring swindlers: clever ones like this are harder to fool.

Text:
そんな人も　しっかりだませるよう
私といっしょに　勉強していきましょうね

English.Text: But so long as you continue to train and apply yourselves, I can teach you to swindle even the toughest marks!

Text: はい！

English.Text: Yessir!

Text:
では　これは
お約束していた景品です

English.Text: As for you─rest assured that I am a man of my word.

Text:
砂漠で野菜は貴重品
嘘はついてないですよね？

English.Text: Those greens are hard to find in a place like this. Quite the handsome reward, wouldn't you say?

Text:
みなさん『嘘を隠すなら真実の中』
という言葉をご存知でしょうか？

English.Text: My dear pupils, are you familiar with the phrase "the best lies are told in truths"?

Text:
嘘を　うまくつくコツは
真実に混ぜることです

English.Text: The trick to deceiving someone is to pad your fiction with facts.

Text:
その　ブレンドテクニックこそが
詐欺師の極意と言っていいでしょう

English.Text: Learn to couch your lies among statements that are true, and you'll be a super-swindler!

Text:
その極意がすべて書かれている指南書を
なんと　本日は格安で販売いたします！

English.Text: And as luck would have it, I've brought with me a guidebook that details how to master this art─which I'm offering today at a special low price!

Text:
みなさん
いい顔つきになってきましたね

English.Text: My friends, I'm so proud of all the progress you've made.

Text:
隙のない眼差し
すっかり詐欺師の顔です

English.Text: That devious look in your eyes tells me you're hungry for more knowledge.

Text:
そろそろ
上級者コースに進むときですね

English.Text: Perhaps it's time we move on to some more advanced lessons.

Text:
受講料はすこしだけ高くなりますが
ご安心ください

English.Text: The tuition is a bit steeper than before, but do not let that deter you.

Text: 詐欺師になれば　すぐに取り戻せますよ

English.Text: You'll make it all back and more once you become a pro like me.

Text:
みなさん
ウータイの映像はご覧になりましたか

English.Text: My friends, I presume you've seen the broadcast out of Wutai.

Text: 私はあれを見て　心底感嘆いたしました

English.Text: So shocking. I could scarce believe my eyes and ears.

Text:
嘘と真実の混ぜ方
話術とボディランゲージ

English.Text: The way they twisted words and visuals, interweaving fact with fiction...

Text: どれをとっても一級品です！

English.Text: It was a master class in deception!

Text:
実は特別に
録画映像を入手しましたので

English.Text: As it happens, I managed to procure a recording of the broadcast.

Text:
みなさんに格別のお値段で
お譲りしたいと考えています

English.Text: And I'm offering copies to you at a very special pupil discount!

Text: 血に飢えたツワモノたちよ　よく来たな

English.Text: Got a lust for blood? Then you've come to the right place!

Text:
選りすぐりのモンスターをそろえて
待っていたぞ！

English.Text: All our most ferocious fiends are champing at the bit!

Text: リングにあがれば　邪魔者はいない

English.Text: In the ring, it's man versus monster.

Text: 生きるも死ぬも　おまえ次第！

English.Text: No one to save you from a grisly demise but yourself!

Text:
さあ　スリルに身をゆだねる準備は
できたか？

English.Text: Think you can walk on the wild side and live to tell the tale?

Text: クールで熱いバトルを見せてくれ！

English.Text: Then step into the battleground and unleash the beast within!

Text: ビーストバトルグラウンドへ　ようこそ

English.Text: Welcome to Beast Battleground!

Text:
上では味わえない
刺激的な遊びを体験してみるか？

English.Text: So─you lookin' for a thrill you won't find anywhere up top?

Text:
モンスターとのバトルに勝てば
新鮮野菜がもらえるぜ？

English.Text: Defeat a few fiends and there could be some fresh new greens in it for ya!

Text: ヒュ～　やるじゃねえか

English.Text: Whew! Look at you go.

Text:
ほかにもデンジャラスなイベントをやってるからよ
気が向いたら　また寄ってくれ

English.Text: Be sure to check out some of our other contests too, if you're in the market for a little danger.

Text:
話は聞いてるよ　なんでも屋くん
きみ　野菜を探してるんだって？

English.Text: No need to say a word. I already know your story. You're on the hunt for chocobo greens, am I right?

Text:
そこでだ　野菜を分けるかわりに
ひとつ仕事を引き受けてくれないか？

English.Text: Well...I'd be willing to scratch your back─provided you'd be willing to scratch mine.

Text:
話は聞いてるよ　なんでも屋くん
実は　きみに頼みたい仕事があるんだ

English.Text: No need to say a word. I already know your story. In fact, I've got a very special job with your name on it.

Text:
私が仕切っている広場のカジノに
風変わりなカードバウターたちが居座っていてね

English.Text: My casino happens to be plagued by a gaggle of rather...eccentric Queen's Blood players.

Text:
彼らを倒してもらいたいんだ
どうだろう　やってくれるかい？

English.Text: I'd love it if someone could take them down a notch or two. So, think you're up to the task?

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: I'll handle it.

Text: 助かる

English.Text: Much obliged.

Text:
変わった連中だが　腕は立つみたいでね
挑戦者が減ってしまって　困っていたんだ

English.Text: Outlandish though they are, they play a mean game─so mean that it's scaring away my clientele.

Text: いちどでも勝ってみせれば　また盛りあがるだろう

English.Text:
I need someone to get out there
and prove they can be beaten.

Text:
カードバウターは３人
広場のカジノにいるはずだ

English.Text:
Got three troublemakers in total.
Still looking for action, no doubt.

Text: よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Thanks in advance.

Text:
それじゃあ　うちのカードを見ていってくれ
カードバウトの役に立つかもしれない

English.Text:
Before you go though, you should take a look
at the cards I have for sale. I guarantee they'll
come in handy.

Text: 話は聞いたよ　なんでも屋くん

English.Text: No need to say a word. I know your story.

Text:
きみ　カジノにいたカードバウターを
倒してくれたんだって？

English.Text: I also happen to know that you've racked up a few QB wins at the casino.

Text:
私は　カジノを仕切っていてね
連中には手を焼いていたんだ

English.Text: As its owner, allow me to express my gratitude. Some players have no restraint.

Text:
カードバウターは全員で３人
その調子で　残りも倒してもらえると助かる

English.Text: Incidentally, there are three troublemakers in total. You'd be doing me a favor if you were to beat them all.

Text:
そうだな　報酬は野菜でどうかな？
よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Here's an idea: do it and I'll give you some greens in exchange. Sound like a deal?

Text:
カードバウターは全員で３人
その調子で　残りも倒してもらえると助かる

English.Text: There are three troublemakers in total, actually. If you were to beat them all, I'd be quite grateful.

Text: よろしく頼むよ

English.Text: Thanks in advance.

Text:
それじゃあ　うちのカードを見ていってくれ
カードバウトの役に立つかもしれない

English.Text: Before you go, though, you should take a look at the cards I have for sale. I guarantee they'll come in handy.

Text:
助かったよ　これは礼だ
受け取ってくれ

English.Text:
You did me a great favor.
Take this as a token of my thanks.

Text:
そうだ　きみのような凄腕バウターに
オススメのカードがあるんだ

English.Text: Before you go, though, I have some cards I'd highly recommend for a player as skilled as yourself.

Text: ぜひ　見ていってくれ

English.Text: You won't want to miss out.

Text: 来たね　なんでも屋くん

English.Text: And there's the man of the hour.

Text: きみが勝ってくれたおかげで

English.Text: Thanks to your efforts...

Text:
下火になっていたクイーンズ・ブラッドに
また　火がついたよ

English.Text: demand for Queen's Blood is back and stronger than ever. It's at an all-time high!

Text: これで　しばらくは稼げそうだ

English.Text: Which means my profits should be too.

Text:
助かったよ　これは礼だ
受け取ってくれ

English.Text:
You did me a great favor.
Take this as a token of my thanks.

Text:
そうだ　きみのような凄腕バウターに
オススメのカードがあるんだ

English.Text: Before you go, though, I have some cards I'd highly recommend for a player as skilled as yourself.

Text: ぜひ　見ていってくれ

English.Text: You won't want to miss out.

Text:
どれも自慢のカードたちだ
じっくり見ていってくれ

English.Text: Only cards of the highest quality, guaranteed. Browse as long as you like.

Text: カードバウトの調子はどうだい？

English.Text: How are your QB games going?

Text:
ウータイの放送は見た？
久しぶりに場が動きそうだ　面白くなってきた

English.Text: Did you see Wutai's broadcast? Sounds like things are about to get very interesting. Personally, I can't wait.

Text: 依頼している仕事のほうも　しっかり頼むよ

English.Text: Remember: I'm still counting on you to get that job done.

Text:
カジノにいるカードバウターたちは
倒してくれたかな？

English.Text: Have you managed to beat any of those Queen's Blood players yet?

Text:
強すぎる者がいると　場が硬直してしまう
たまには負けてもらわないとね

English.Text: People lose interest when they start thinking they can't win. That's why it's important to shake things up once in a while.

Text:
それと　くれぐれもカジノのことは上に漏らすなよ
牢獄暮らしはゴメンだろ？

English.Text: By the way, don't breathe a word about this to the folks upstairs...unless you want to find yourself behind bars again.

Text:
気が向いたら　またクイーンズ・ブラッドを
盛りあげてってくれ

English.Text: I wouldn't mind you stoking more interest in Queen's Blood, if you're ever in the mood.

Text: うちのカジノでは　勝ちすぎないでくれよ

English.Text: Feel free to win, but don't let it get out of hand.

Text:
飲んだくれの酒場
ベイル・ジャンパーへようこそ

English.Text:
Welcome to Bail Jumper, watering hole
for the dregs of the Dustbowl.

Text: あんた　野菜が欲しいんだって？

English.Text: Heard you're in the market for some greens.

Text: ああ

English.Text: Maybe.

Text:
なら　崖の上に畑があるからよ
勝手にとってっていいぞ

English.Text:
If so, I've got a garden up on the cliff.
Everything's yours for the taking.

Text:
ずっとほったらかしだが　なんかあるだろ
ほら　これで行けるからよ

English.Text: Assuming there's anything to take. Haven't tended to it in ages. Here, go see for yourself.

Text:
ただ　あそこはモンスターが出るからよ
気をつけるんだな

English.Text:
Be sure to keep an eye out for fiends, though.
Place is crawling with 'em.

Text:
日当たりがいいところに畑を作ったものの
道が険しすぎてな　ほったらかしよ

English.Text: Found the one place around here that had a spot of green, but the road there's so rough, I stopped goin'.

Text:
ずっと　放置しちまってるが
すこしは生き残ってんだろ

English.Text: Haven't tended to those plants in ages, but I'm sure something's still alive.

Text:
邪魔になるから　ぼくはここで待ってるよ
野菜　頼んだよ

English.Text: I'll wait right here─leave the green huntin' to you. Wouldn't wanna get in the way.

Text:
また行くの？
じゃあ　ここで待ってるね

English.Text:
Goin' for more?
Well, be here if you need me.

Text: 野菜　なかったの？

English.Text: Didn't find nothin'?

Text: 野菜　手に入ったみたいだね！

English.Text: Got your hands on some greens, huh?

Text: おかえり

English.Text: Howdy.

Text:
野菜は手に入ったか　そうか……
ほったらかし農業　案外イケるもんだな

English.Text: Got those greens you were after? Well, good. Guess my hands-off farming method works better than I thought.

Text:
１杯やってくか？
味の保証はしねえがな

English.Text: Here to wet your whistle? I can fix you a drink if you like.

Text: ウスいって文句言いやがったら　ぶん殴るからな

English.Text: Just don't go complainin' that it tastes "weak"─it's delicate.

Text:
ウータイのことがあって
酒をちょっと　濃くしたんだ

English.Text: Been watering down the drinks less, what with the news outta Wutai.

Text: 酔えるうちに　酔っとかねえとな

English.Text: Can't deal with that shit sober.
